judges.rationale: Top 10 by median-y2 x p(median), skeptic-adjusted, ceiling as tiebreaker. 1 I054 roll-off dumpsters: highest raw EV ($130K x 0.55) and the best-documented cash business at its capital level; skeptic only trims. 2 I001 pest control route: $100K x 0.6, skeptic says numbers hold, 9/10 durability. 3 I028 SBA trades-shop acquisition: $60K EV plus a $1.5M ceiling, the only card where the skeptic calls the arbitrage real. 4 I012 generator load-bank testing: mandated recurring demand, $55K EV, data-center tailwind. 5 I002 septic pumping: $54K EV, skeptic confirms low-100s income. 6 I075 outbound contact-rate compliance boutique: $58.5K EV and skeptic agrees the ops gap is real. 7 I037 forward-deployed AI engineer: $59.5K EV; even the skeptic's fallback (1099 at $100-200/hr) clears the median. 8 I082 fractional contact-center head: $60K EV, discounted for relationship-sold ramp. 9 I036 enterprise AI AE: nominal $63K EV, but skeptic's mid-market $120-160K OTE cuts it to ~$50K. 10 I017 show-rate desk: $54K EV, thin moat. Next five fell short: I050 spreadsheet-to-app ($54K) is discounted because buyers can vibe-code and every agency claims it; I055 mulching and I059 mobile RV tech ($50K) need heavy equipment or 6-12 months of certification before year-2 income is real; I039 ICE officer has p=0.6 but an 8-month academy and 5/10 durability; I026 septic install ($49.5K) needs OSSF licensing plus $150K capital against entrenched locals. Fatal-at-capital cards (I025, I027, I030, I073) and near-fatal probability cards (I079, I099, I007, I096, I091) sit at the bottom regardless of headline EV.

Top 10: I028 (buy a trades shop with SBA leverage) is the only card whose ceiling is a PE multiple on a durable, sellable cash-flowing asset. I100 (Medicare Advantage renewal book) compounds automatically under CMS-fixed commissions and sells as a book. I107 (fire/life-safety ITM routes), I012 (load-bank testing), I001 (pest control), I013 (medical waste), and I054 (roll-off dumpsters) are code- or habit-mandated recurring routes with consolidator exits and no AI displacement. I106 (cost segregation) and I098 (property-tax protest) ride permanent tax law and annual re-enrollment with $1M ceilings. I067 (home care) is a licensed, recurring, sellable agency in a demographically guaranteed market. Next five: I082 and I036/I037 pay the most in year two but are jobs with no compounding asset and AI-vendor-cycle exposure; I075 (DID reputation service) has the best fit and recurring retainers but sits on outbound calling, a channel AI and carrier policy keep shrinking; I032 (nurse staffing) has a real book but VMS gatekeeping, factoring float, and rate compression cap the durable margin; I015 (estate cleanout) is durable but transactional, so it never compounds into a book. Bottom: expired or negative-EV windows (I079, I099, I007) and capital-fatal plays (I025, I027, I030, I073).

Top 10, in order: I075 (outbound contact-rate/TCPA managed service: $5K capital, first dollar in ~2 months, the asker already runs the exact playbook and owns the DID dashboard), I017 (show-rate guarantee desk: $10K, performance-priced so buyers say yes fast, perfect fit), I050 (spreadsheet-to-app studio: $2K, fixed-fee projects close in weeks, AI-assisted solo shipping is his existing skill), I085 (dialer migration plus contingency telecom audit: $2K, sells on savings, 10/10 fit), I082 (fractional contact-center head: $0 capital, highest reachable median at $150K, only cost is relationship ramp), I076 (book-rate turnaround for PE trades platforms: $2K, $25-60K engagements), I048 (aged-lead AI SDR: $5K, pay-per-show removes buyer friction), I036 (enterprise AI-voice AE: $0 capital, $180K median, contact-center domain is the hook), I093 (LinkedIn ghostwriting: $0, first dollar in a month), I038 (storm roofing 1099 sales: $2K, no license, commission in month one). The next five fell just short: I094 AI-literacy training is cheap and fast but its window is closing and credibility must be built; I001 pest control is well-documented but needs a TDA license and $40K before route density pays; I066 senior-living placement carries FTC/state disclosure risk and lead cost; I037 FDE contracting hits technical-interview screens that AI-assisted shipping does not pass; I081 membership retention desk has a slow human sell against dunning software. Fatal/near-fatal cards (I025, I027, I030, I073, I007, I079, I091, I096, I099) sit at the bottom; nothing in the dossiers overturned those flags.
